trigger.description: The model-lifecycle readiness probe could not read semantic index status (for example the index directory is unreadable, or the in-query status probe failed), so no dimension-compatibility evidence exists. Readiness is reported as unknown (not probed) rather than as an unavailable model, because no index rebuild or re-embed can repair a probe failure and the active embedding backend still served the request.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Cargo workspace uses Rust nightly.' --workspace . --level semantic --kind fact --json
# make .ee/index unreadable so the index-status probe fails (e.g. replace the directory with a regular file)
